name: Download Telegram attachment
description: Downloads a Telegram file_id into an optional destination directory. Returns ref, fileName (actual stored name), file_id and size, with file_name (original name) and contentType when known. Optional fileName overrides the original filename retained from an admitted message; otherwise a safe original name is preferred, with a generated fallback. Conflicts use report(1).pdf, report(2).pdf, etc.; files are never overwritten. Omit destination for the bot owner's private DLFS telegram drive. Explicit directories use caller write authority and a content provider supporting create-only writes (DLFS or configured file roots); parent directories must exist. Requires telegram/call on the bot. Maximum 20 MiB; no token-bearing URL is returned.

destination.description: Optional directory reference, e.g. dlfs/imports or file://inbox (trailing slash optional). Uses caller write authority. Omit for the bot owner's private DLFS telegram drive.

fileName.description: Optional safe basename, not a path (at most 200 UTF-8 bytes). Overrides the remembered Telegram filename; conflicts receive a numeric suffix without added spaces.
